metadata.description: Production intelligence SRE stack for Claude Code — bring real service-mesh truth into your IDE.

plugins.name: karmaiq-core
plugins.description: Baseline karmaIQ MCP connection, active-domain picker, exploring-service-mesh skill, and help/discoverability skill. Install first — required by all other karmaIQ plugins.

plugins.name: karmaiq-firefighter
plugins.description: Autonomous SRE for production incident root-cause analysis via karmaIQ. Pre-warms service lookups when you mention APIs or services. Requires karmaiq-core.

plugins.name: karmaiq-impact
plugins.description: Pre-change blast-radius analysis. Auto-loads in code files; on git commit, scans the staged diff and hints the impact of changed methods. Requires karmaiq-core.

plugins.name: karmaiq-architect
plugins.description: Structural risk review across the karmaIQ service mesh — cycles, single points of failure, orphan services, dead code, hot methods, fan analysis. Requires karmaiq-core.

plugins.name: karmaiq-promotion-gate
plugins.description: Canary regression verdict for promotion gates — STABLE / WATCH / REGRESSION / INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Manual invocation only. Requires karmaiq-core.
